title: Order fulfilment
goal: Show a complete e-commerce order path from intake through dispatch with realistic exceptions.

rubric.must: A payment-authorisation decision visibly sends a No branch to a cancelled-order terminator.
An inventory-availability decision visibly separates the pick-and-pack path from a backorder-or-refund path.
The successful path visibly runs from reserved inventory through pick list, picking, packing, carrier collection, and dispatch.
A customer-accepted backorder visibly loops back toward inventory reservation.
A failed carrier collection visibly leads to a hold step that loops back to collection confirmation.
Decision branches are visibly labelled so the success and failure outcomes can be distinguished.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG satisfies all six rules, while the picture changes the payment-failure and backorder logic and omits required fulfilment and carrier-collection steps.
